streamflow-fetch: Two-panel chart for Fish River near Fort Kent, ME, 1 October 1995 to 30 September 2000. Top: daily discharge in cubic metres per second with one sharp spring peak each year, up to about 306 in April 1996; days above the P95 threshold of 170.9 are shaded amber with diagonal hatching and fall only in April and May of 1996, 1997, 1998 and 2000. Bottom: mean discharge by calendar month, highest in April and May (about 130 and 145) and lowest from July to October.
